So the net force is upward, causing a negative acceleration (since acceleration is opposite to the direction of the net force). So acceleration should become negative, and velocity becomes negative.

But the analysis concluded that acceleration remains positive. That's the mistake. So the error is in thinking that acceleration becomes negative, but the analysis says it remains positive. So the mistake is in the analysis, which is in the lower half of the segment.
